notes.title: Release Date Confirmed! ~ Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025 ~
notes.notes:
📢 Fruitimo! will be released on September 18, 2025 (Thu)! 🍓
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/7c799a695d6a556d292b328db1dc7e61b136fb24.png"]

🎮 Tokyo Game Show 2025 🎮
We’re excited to announce that Fruitimo! will be playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025, held from September 25 (Thu) to 28 (Sun).

Come and try it out at our booth in the Indie Game Area: \[11-E02]!



✨ Don’t forget to add Fruitimo! to your Wishlist on Steam!

👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/3345000/_/



And be sure to check out our social media—we’re posting fun updates every day!
